settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.showSourceTagsHint: Display textbook sources and custom tags at the bottom of case cards
settingsPage.autoVerifyHint: Automatically verify a case once it is generated
settingsPage.autoFixHint: Automatically correct a case when verification fails
settingsPage.modelSubtitle: Set a default model for each scene
settingsPage.sceneHint: Choose the model scene to bind
settingsPage.quickTemplatesHint: Choose "Blank" to enter an API key, base URL and model name without any preset
settingsPage.comfyHintChat: Local ComfyUI must run on the same machine as this service; cloud deployments cannot reach a local address. The local text-generation template below is active, using the on-device Qwen3 4B model for chat, cases, stories, tests and evaluations. System instructions and chat history are merged into one prompt for the workflow, and streaming responses are returned once generation finishes. Change the model name to any other value to use a custom remote OpenAI-compatible chat API.
settingsPage.comfyHintImage: Local ComfyUI must run on the same machine as this service; cloud deployments cannot reach a local address. The local templates below are active. Change the model name to any other value to use a custom remote OpenAI-compatible image API. Story illustrations use the generated patient avatar as the input image.
settingsPage.comfyHintVideo: Local ComfyUI must run on the same machine as this service; cloud deployments cannot reach a local address. The local image-to-video template below is active, using the generated patient avatar as the first frame; MiniMax H3 / FastVideo FastH3 models must be installed locally. Video size follows the first frame and the frame rate is fixed at 24 FPS. Change the model name to any other value to use a custom remote video API.
settingsPage.comfyHintAudio: Local ComfyUI must run on the same machine as this service; cloud deployments cannot reach a local address. Only chat, image and video scenes are integrated; audio is not yet supported.
settingsPage.apiKeyHint: Key for the custom provider (leave empty if not required)
settingsPage.modelNameHint: Once set, a "Custom" provider appears in the model selector for this scene
settingsPage.chatTemplateHint: Used for all text generation, including chat, cases, stories, tests and evaluations, with models installed on this machine
settingsPage.i2vTemplateHint: Used by Video with the generated patient avatar as the first frame
settingsPage.t2iTemplateHint: Used by custom generation and patient avatars, with models installed on this machine
settingsPage.editTemplateHint: Used by story illustrations, with the generated patient avatar as the input image
settingsPage.comfyTemplateNote: These templates only apply to local ComfyUI; other model names use a custom remote {type} API.
